name: daemon install+start under isolated label
label: com.chirality.runtime.tranchetest
installer: node evidence/la-driver.mjs (LaunchAgentManager from runtime/packages/cli/dist, options identical to frontend createDesktopDaemonLifecycle() + test label/dir)

boundaries.before: launchctl print -> Could not find service (not loaded)

timings.note: start() = bootstrap (RunAtLoad -> run 1) then kickstart -k (run 2); the 10s is ThrottleInterval gating the redundant kickstart

findings: runs=2 after a single 'start': RunAtLoad already launched the job at bootstrap, then kickstart -k restarted it. Harmless but doubles the launch count and costs one full ThrottleInterval (10s) per start.
activation policy 'prohibited' does NOT remove the LaunchServices registration: lsappinfo still lists ASN 0x0-0x42f82f4 bundleID com.chirality.app for the daemon pid, reclassified type=UIElement.
